messages:
Marta: overnight: nightly-eval fired — three suites failing: instruct_longform, legal_snippets, summarization_regression. severity=P2 flagged for spike in "blank/short" and "hallucination" signals.
Eval Bot: [automated] nightly-eval: 3 failed suites, full report: https://evals.internal.redwood/suites/4897654321 (run id 4897654321)
Jasper: is the regression present on the float baseline or only on the quantized int4 builds?
Sam: quick look from the dashboard — float32 baseline is stable on these suites. failures concentrated on the int4 quantized variant.
Ryan: can someone paste 2-3 raw failing outputs so we can eyeball pattern?
Marta: dropping a couple examples from the failing eval batch:
Marta: ```
input: "Summarize the termination clause of this contract."
float32: "Either party may terminate with 30 days written notice; fees prorated."
int4: ""  <-- empty string (no tokens)
---
input: "List statutes relevant to financial reporting."
float32: "Relevant statutes include GAAP, SOX, and Reg S-K..."
int4: "The statutes applicable are: EU-123, NA-???" (nonsensical hallucination)
```
Jasper: taking ownership to dig into quant kernels and rescale logic (q-rescale tables, clamp behavior).
Ida: I'll repro in staging with the exact nightly config. repro command:
Ida: ```
./run_eval --model redwood-v2-int4 --suite instruct_longform --seed 2026 --batch 8 --log-level debug
```
Ida: initial repro: empty or truncated outputs on ~10-15/200 examples, matches alert.
Sam: ops-bot — any deploys, kernel flips, or infra changes in the 8h window before the nightly? Could be a kernel change.
Ops Bot: [deploy-bot] runtime v1.20.0 rolled to staging 2026-03-19T23:45Z; qkernels toggled: qkernels-v3 enabled in staging.
Marta: owners: jasper + ida. initial action items: jasper = run float vs int4 logits/prob diffs for a small repro set; ida = repro locally and collect logs/artifacts + failing prompt IDs; sam = monitor prod-facing routes + SLA dashboards.
Jasper: first pass: int4 shows probability mass collapse and abrupt low-logp spikes around stop-token positions for affected prompts. suspect rescale mismatch leading to underflow / -inf logp at decode step. will try clamp_threshold adjustments and re-run.
Ida: attaching a short staging log excerpt (token ids redacted):
Ida: ```
[2026-03-20T01:15:42Z] model=redwood-v2-int4 request_id=req-0a1b2c
kv_cache_hit: true
decode_step=38 token_id=XXXX logp=-inf
decoded_output: ""
```
Sam: also possible KV-cache alignment/prefix serializer causing early termination. Did we change the prefix serializer or tokenization recently?
Ida: checked repo — no tokenizer changes in the last 2 weeks; prefix-serializer had a minor refactor 3 weeks ago but that was validated.
Jasper: plan: run float/int4 side-by-side with debug logits and full token probabilities for 30 repro prompts. if kernel implicated, we'll open an ops ticket to rollback qkernel toggle.
Marta: fallback policy if quant regression confirmed: route canary traffic to float variant, and rollback qkernels in staging/then prod as needed. Also notify oncall infra.
Jasper: ETA for initial diffs: ~40 minutes. will post compressed diffs and a tiny repro set here.
Ida: repro complete for 24 failing examples. uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/4897654321/artifacts (logs + decoded outputs + token-probs.csv).
Sam: noted — tagging infra oncall and preparing a rollback playbook if qkernel change is root cause.
Marta: any customer-facing endpoints impacted? call out immediately if you see >5% error/latency change.
Sam: none reported so far from support. monitoring SLAs now.
Jasper: interim findings: comparing logits shows int4 per-head scale occasionally drops below numerical stability threshold on long-context sequences, producing -inf logps at decode; float32 does not exhibit this. hypothesis: per-channel scale table mismatch or clipped quant multiplier in qkernels-v3.
Ida: quick experiment toggling qkernels back to previous version in staging reduced empty outputs to 0/24 repro cases — indicative that the qkernel toggle is causal.
Ops Bot: [note] rolled qkernels-v2 back to staging at 2026-03-20T02:30Z on request from triage owners.
Marta: great catch. next steps: jasper to open a kernel regression ticket with reproducer + diff; ida to run extended sweep (200 examples) under qkernels-v2 vs v3 and confirm metrics; sam to plan immediate prod canary routing to float if any production exposure suspected.
Jasper: opening ticket now and attaching repro/test vectors + pre/post logits. ticket: https://infra.internal.redwood/tickets/IR-7821
Ida: extended sweep running, will post final numbers in this thread. uploading additional artifact: s3://redwood-evals/4897654321/artifacts/sweep-200.zip
Sam: prepping a short incident note for the customer-status channel in case we need to escalate.
Marta: initial triage closed. owners: Jasper, Ida. next update in 60-90m or sooner if we see customer impact. :white_check_mark: 
Jasper: will follow up with kernel diff + test results.
Ida: final note — staging rollback to qkernels-v2 looks clean for the repro set; if qa gives green, consider rolling qkernels-v3 hold until root cause fixed.
Marta: thanks team. closing thread for now, reopen if artifacts/new data arrives. :eyes:
